changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[reporting].[Global_resource]') AND name = 'UpdatedOn') BEGIN alter table reporting.Global_resource add UpdatedOn datetime END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[reporting].[Global_resource]') AND name = 'UpdatedOn') BEGIN alter table reporting.Global_resource drop column UpdatedOn END
